audit.why: 50.82% over 122 games and an EVEN 6/10 rating. Aurora owns 2-3 and both item stages on range (Twofold Hex 900 vs Winds of War 825); Galio's windows are the 4-6 stretch where Justice Punch into Shield of Durand can actually land. The recorded sides match the mirror audit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 phase named her ultimate "Between the Worlds" and treated 6 as a lane spike, when Hero's Entrance is not a laning ability at all.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance is 180/160/140 seconds and 4000/4750/5500 range — it targets an ally's position, not yours. In a 1v1 lane with no ally nearby it does nothing, so his 6 spike is map pressure, not lane pressure. Between Worlds at 140s is actually the shorter cooldown of the two at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Hero's Entrance (180s) lands on an ally, not on you — his 6 is a map spike, so your 140s Between Worlds still owns the 1v1.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text, mid and whys[4] all say Aurora's W "goes untargetable". Across the Veil grants invisibility, not untargetability — a real difference against a taunt, which is a targeted effect. Separately, Shield of Durand is described only as a taunt, and its charge-up — the thing that makes it dodgeable — is never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot's Across the Veil text: 'entering the spirit realm upon landing, becoming invisible, and gaining Move Speed.' Riot's Shield of Durand (W, 18/17/16/15/14, 275): 'Galio charges a defensive stance, moving slowly. Upon releasing the charge, Galio will taunt and damage nearby enemies.' He is slowed while charging and the taunt only fires on release at 275 units — so the answer is to walk out of that radius during the charge, which is free, rather than to spend Across the Veil. Justice Punch (E, 11/10/9/8/7, 650) 'will briefly step back and charge, knocking up the first enemy champion he encounters' — the step-back is the tell, and the first champion hit stops it, so a minion between you does nothing but a teammate does.
audit.corrected: Shield of Durand charges before it taunts and only reaches 275 units — walk out during the charge instead of spending W.

audit.whatIsWrong: Justice Punch is tracked as the matchup-defining cooldown with no number.
audit.why: Justice Punch is 11s at rank 1 and Shield of Durand is 18s — the taunt is the longer, more punishable one, and it is the half of the combo that actually holds you still.
audit.corrected: Justice Punch is 11s; Shield of Durand is 18s — the taunt is the longer window.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing says what Galio's ultimate means for the rest of the map.
audit.why: Hero's Entrance reaches 5500 units at rank 3 and shields every ally at the landing point. Once he hits 6, a shoved wave means he leaves and a fight elsewhere becomes 5v4 — that changes what you do with the wave more than it changes your trades.
audit.corrected: At 6 he roams on a 180s ultimate — shove and follow, or ping the map before he lands on it.

edits.after: Hero's Entrance (180s) lands on an ally, not on you — his 6 is a map spike, so your 140s Between Worlds still owns the lane 1v1.
